title: Gideon
sourceLines: -Angel attests the call to, by miracle Jud 6:21-24
-He destroys the altar of Baal, and builds one to the Lord Jud 6:25-27
-Leads an army against and defeats the Midianites Jud 6:33-35; 7; 8:4-12
-Reproaches the Ephraimites for not joining in the campaign against the Midianites Jud 8:1-3
-Avenges himself upon the people of Succoth Jud 8:14-17
-Israel desires to make him king; he refuses Jud 8:22,23
-Makes an ephod which becomes a snare to the Israelites Jud 8:24-27
